text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Air Shakur gathers a
variety of
data each day leading up to
the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clang!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, get me a tape measure! I need take
some
quick measurements.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
My triceps surae have grown 1.2
centimeters, but
no change in my
gastrocnemius.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We'll measure them again every five
minutes. After they've returned to their
original size, I'm
gonna pump them up
again.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Five minutes after that, we'll check their
size
difference again. Get ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And another time...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...That tab shows the biometric data
received
from my devices. It allows you
to monitor my stats
in real time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur installs her homemade
measurement app to my phone, and my
eyes are immediately
attacked by the
UI's violently bright colors.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Got a problem with it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Shut it. UI isn't my specialty.
choice_data_list: Maybe a color that's a bit easier ...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've managed to keep my lap times at a
high standard. Next, I'll work on
collecting some detailed cornering data,
and come up with a way to shorten my
lap times even more.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Call out the values shown after each lap,
and I'll
make the necessary adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just call out the values in order. Nothing
else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our data collection goes smoothly and
her results are drawing closer to the
theoretical values required to become a
Double Crown champion. Our
preparations continue, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We don't even have seven centimeters
of room to spare. Maybe instead of
runnin' your mouth, how
about you start
runnin' your brain?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've still yet to uncover decisive data
for her
future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her data collection is nothing short of
extensive. If there's any data that could
truly be useful to
her, it would have to
be...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Emotion is an unstable variable,
however, so it's
inefficient to convert
into data.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If the issue is just efficiency...
then the data itself
would still be useful, right? I
just have to put in
the time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road! Hi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road is in the year above Air
Shakur.
She drew a lot of attention after
winning the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You're looking awful serious. Is there
something
on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You can tell me about if you'd like. I
might be
able to lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Stop right there, Top Road!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If anyone understands this trainer's
anguish, it is I!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
They've been enchanted by the very
incarnation
of beauty—yours truly, T.M.
Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened! You're
incredible,
Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O, the winner of this year's
Satsuki Sho... She's a year above Shakur,
like Narita Top
Road and Shakur's
roommate, Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They've already experienced classic
year's intense
trials and tribulations.
They know what Shakur's
up for.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But of course! As does anyone standing
on the
grand stage of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But of co—uh, come again?
choice_data_list: You understand what racing is all ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their stories might reveal "unquantifiable
influences"—useful data
that Parcae hasn't
factored into Shakur's
future!
choice_data_list: I know it defies logic, as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I guess I still don't have enough data.
choice_data_list: I'd like to hear what you have to ...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(My body is steadily growing stronger,
and my
stats are rising as the simulation
predicted. But...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(This is my limit. I can't envision myself
overtaking
the predicted losses.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(But even knowing that, all I can do is
keep going
forward. Even if I know the
road ahead leads
directly into hell...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Let's change your destiny."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't need any tagalongs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask Air Shakur to meet me the
following day,
and she shows up without
a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Is that right? Let's hear it, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"How to turn people's expectation into
strength."
...Was that Narita Top Road?
choice_data_list: I gathered data on the unknown fac...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If you ask me, having people who
support me is
one of the most important
things there is!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to live up to their expectations. I
don't
want to let them down, no matter
what.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That kind of thinking gives me the
strength to persevere, even when the
going gets tough. Those expectations
give me the strength to take those final
steps.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I felt so thankful for that at the Kikuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the Kikuka Sho! Well, I'd seen her
crying
during the Derby, so...

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I was cheering my head
off at the Kikuka Sho! I ended up
shouting so hard, my
throat was sore for
days after.

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan
text_block_list.text:
I guess everyone was probably feeling
the same.
We knew she could win—no,
more than that... We
wanted her to win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even though I was totally focused on the
race, I
could still hear them cheering.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That became my strength. As I neared
the finish line, my heart was pounding
and the other racers were closing in on
me. Honestly, it was incredibly tough.
But...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's voices were propelling me
forward!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure I could've pushed through
and won
without that support.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I analyzed every race she competed in, 
converting the progression of her lap
times and running tendencies into
formulas for comparison.
In doing so..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"The resulting data suggests that her
speed in the final spurt of the Kikuka
Sho, where she believes the cheers
propelled her forward, was slightly 
higher than in other races."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Based on the above, we can conclude that
emotional support from fans was
indeed a factor
in Narita Top Road's
victory at the Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Okay. And what am I supposed to do
with this?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's useless to me. This only applies to
Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's true that certain conditions can
produce
results that surpass calculations.
choice_data_list: I just thought it might be helpful.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But do you seriously think I can raise my potential with fan support?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What capacity?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Illogical...
choice_data_list: Still, Shakur might have that side...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me! Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...If the "influence" is so miniscule that
it's within
the margin of error, what's to
say it had an impact
at all?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
When I mentioned unquantifiable
influences, I
meant clear statistic
miracles—not rose-tinted
maybes.
choice_data_list: You have some idea, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I thought I told you before that adding
things like
this to my calculations was
inefficient.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So what now? You're gonna run around
chatting
to random people and
compiling it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: Still, you actually managed to col...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't think it's gonna change anything.
choice_data_list: I want that incorporated into the ...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe all the fractional little influences
she's
been rounding out would add up.
choice_data_list: Still, it might make a 0.01 cm dif...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh.
choice_data_list: Maybe it'll be down to 6.99 cm tom...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's some far-fetched logic. Even if the
gap
shrinks, there's no guarantee it'll hit
zero.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But... sure. I suppose you're not wrong.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'll give your data some consideration.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So that's what you've come up with,
huh?
